name: Lushan National Park
description: Rising between the Yangtze River and Poyang Lake in Jiangxi province, Mount Lushan is a misty, forested massif long regarded as one of the spiritual heartlands of Chinese civilization. Buddhist and Taoist temples and Confucian academies, where renowned masters taught, are scattered across its slopes. Its dramatic scenery inspired generations of Chinese painters and poets and helped shape the nation's way of seeing nature.
